idea: How to save water at home
title: How to Catch a Silent Water Leak at Home
description: One of the most common causes of high water bills is a silent toilet leak. A worn flapper or faulty flush valve seal can leak hundreds of gallons a day without making a sound. You can test this in 15 minutes: remove your toilet tank lid and add a few drops of food coloring into the water inside the tank. Wait 20 minutes without flushing. If colored water appears in the toilet bowl, water is leaking past the seal. Replacing a degraded flapper is a simple fix that immediately stops water waste. If the leak continues, consult a licensed plumber to inspect the fill valve assembly.
